verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I said to the children of Israel, “You shall go into the land that I have given you.”
verses.3: And they made an offering to Yahweh, whether it was a sacrifice or a gift given during their festivals. They offered these offerings to Yahweh from morning or from evening.
verses.4: And the one who offered the sacrifice brought his offering to Jehovah. It was a sacrifice of twenty-blocks of barley, divided into two halves.
verses.5: And it shall be sacrificed a fourth time. It will be done on the hill, or for the sacrifice to the one who is called “Kabesh”.
verses.6: Or, as a sacrifice, make a offering of two hundred and fifty pieces of silver, in the form of six shekels.
verses.7: And Yayin will bring a fragrant smell to Jehovah.
verses.8: And if you do so in the morning, or offer sacrifices to Pelah Nedar or Shalemim for Yahweh.
verses.9: And he offered as a sacrifice for the son of the morning, three hundred denarii, mixed with half a hin of honey.
verses.10: And Yayin will offer half of the hin to the Lord as an offering of fragrance.
verses.11: Thus shall it be done with the one horn, or with the one ram, either by means of sticks or by other methods.
verses.12: Just as you will do these things, so too should you do them for one person, just as they were done for another person.
verses.13: All the people shall do this: they shall offer a woman who has a sweet fragrance as an offering to the LORD.
verses.14: And if any man or woman who lives among you behaves in a way that is not proper, and if they make incense for the LORD, then they shall be punished accordingly.
verses.15: The people are subject to one rule for yourselves, but the foreigners are subject to a foreverlasting rule for your days. They will be like foreigners before Jehovah.
verses.16: One law and one judgment will be for you and for the foreigner among you.
verses.17: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.18: I spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “When you go into the land that I will give you, you shall remember this.”
verses.19: And in your eating, from the blood of the land, you shall raise offerings to the LORD.
verses.20: At the beginning of your suffering, you must rise up. You must be like a rose that blooms after being cut down. In the same way, you must also rise up from this situation.
verses.21: From the beginning, you shall offer sacrifices to Jehovah for your sins.
verses.22: And if you do not obey all these commands that Jehovah has given to Moses,
verses.23: All that Jehovah has commanded you through Moses, from the day when Jehovah commanded it, shall be given to your generations.
verses.24: And if it was a mistake in the judgment of the council, and if all the members of the council decided to make one young boy, who would serve as a sacrifice to God. He would be sacrificed according to the law, and one sheep would also be offered as an offering.
verses.25: And the priest shall pronounce a penalty upon every congregation of the children of Israel. But they will be forgiven, because it was an error on their part. They brought their offerings to Jehovah, and their sins were forgiven before Jehovah, due to their mistake.
verses.26: And let all the tribes of Israel be forgiven, along with the foreigners who live among them. For all the people are in error.
verses.27: And if one soul sins through ignorance, and offers as an offering a girl who is still in her youth for sinning.
verses.28: And let the priest lay upon the sinner’s head a penalty for his sins, in ignorance and transgression before Jehovah. Then he shall be forgiven.
verses.29: In the cities of Israel, and among the foreigners living among them, there shall be one rule for all of you. This will serve as a guide for your actions in all matters.
verses.30: And the spirit that acts with a high hand from above, and from among the people, who insults Jehovah, that spirit will be punished. That spirit will be marked as evil by God’s people.
verses.31: For it is known that Jehovah’s words and his commandments were violated by that soul.
verses.32: And the Israelites were in the desert. On the day of the Sabbath, they found a man who was cutting wood.
verses.33: And they brought it to Moses, Aaron, and all the assembly.
verses.34: And they placed him in the prison, because no one knew what would happen to him.
verses.35: And the LORD said to Moses, “Let them stone him to death. All those who were with him should be killed by stones, outside the camp.”
verses.36: And all the assembly brought him outside the camp. They beat him with stones, and he died, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.37: And the LORD said to Moses, “Let them say.”
verses.38: I spoke to the children of Israel, and I said to them, “Make for yourselves crowns on your shoulders as decorations.” They also made crowns for themselves from the feathers of birds.
verses.39: And it shall be for you a reminder, so that you may see it and remember all the commands of Jehovah. Then you will do them, and you will not turn away from them because of your own hearts or your own eyes, which are deceived by them.
verses.40: So that you may remember and carry out all My commandments, and thus become holy to Me.
verses.41: I am Jehovah, your God. I have brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am Jehovah, your God.
